Checksums are provided (not `SKIP`) for both architectures, verifying source integrity. No system configuration modifications, backdoors, data exfiltration, or attacker-controlled code execution is present. The code is consistent with ordinary AUR packaging practice for bringing a binary application to Arch.

This file does not exhibit any of the genuinely malicious behaviors listed in the guidelines (data exfiltration, hidden code execution, obfuscated commands, backdoors, etc.). It is a straightforward package conversion script.
